bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags up to 12 × 12 × 6 inches and one nonclear clutch up to 6 × 9 inches are permitted; a larger bag must be clear and stay within the size limit.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: A parking pass is required: general parking is $20 plus tax when bought online or $25 on the event day. Lots normally open an hour before the scheduled gate time; overnight parking and tailgating are not allowed.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The designated passenger drop-off zone is outside the South Gate near the Uber Lot; follow staff directions.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and drinks are sold inside and the venue is cashless, with free cash-to-card exchange at Guest Services. Guests may bring food in one clear one-gallon bag per person and up to one gallon of water in a sealed or empty plastic bottle.

accessibility.summary: Accessible parking is in A Lot near the box office, entered through South Gate, first come first served. A valid disability credential and a venue parking pass are required.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The venue prohibits re-entry after leaving; a new ticket would be needed to return.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will Call is at the box office between the main entry gates; bring a photo ID matching the purchasing name. The box office opens at noon on concert days.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Gates generally open 60–120 minutes before showtime, but each show gives the exact time. Guests may pass through metal detectors, pat-downs and bag checks.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
